sources.entry: Halo - A powerful and easy-to-use website building tool (documentation in Chinese). (Demo, Source Code, Clients) GPL-3.0 Java/Docker

summary.one_liner: A curated Chinese-language list of themes, plugins, and tools that extend the Halo 2.0 website/blogging platform.
summary.what_it_does: This is an "awesome" style list of resources around the Halo 2.0 website building tool, written mainly in Chinese. It is organized under "Halo 2.0" with sections for themes, plugins, and other tools, and each of the first two is split into "official" and "community" subsections. The theme section lists starter templates (basic, Vite, Astro, modern front-end stacks) and many ported themes from Hexo, Hugo, Jekyll, WordPress and other blog systems, plus navigation-site themes. The plugin section covers storage backends (Alibaba Cloud OSS, S3-compatible, GitHub, Gitee, Lsky Pro, immich, OpenList/AList), editors (StackEdit, ByteMD, Vditor, wangEditor, Excalidraw, Typst, TikZ), comment systems (Artalk, Twikoo, Waline), search (Meilisearch), code highlighting, SEO and notification tools. The "other" section lists external clients such as a CLI uploader, VSCode and Obsidian publishing plugins, and importers from other platforms. Entries are one-line descriptions with links, and some are marked as unmaintained.
use_cases: find a Halo theme for a blog or portfolio
find a Halo plugin for comments, search, or image storage
publish notes from Obsidian or VSCode to Halo
migrate posts from WordPress or Typecho to Halo
build a navigation/link website on Halo
notable: Separates official and community themes and plugins
Covers many ports of Hexo, Hugo, Jekyll and WordPress themes to Halo
Lists comment, storage, editor and search plugins for Halo
Includes external clients such as Obsidian, VSCode and CLI uploaders
Flags some entries as unmaintained, with alternatives named
caveats: Entries are one-line descriptions with links, not reviewed or tested by the list; quality and maintenance vary
Some listed items are noted as in progress or discontinued (e.g., halo-plugin-meilisearch is marked unmaintained)
